note: Tidecaller Harpooner (unit identity, Tidecallers): drowned whaler, biped, upright; an oilskin sou'wester with a banded sea-blue hat and a long brim tail down the back (the signature), a long navy oilskin coat edged in sea blue, navy trousers, tarred barnacled waders, a rope coil over the left shoulder, a quiver of spare harpoon heads on a sea-blue baldric on the back, kelp and barnacles, a team neck scarf, hip sash and wrist wraps, grey-green drowned flesh with gill slits. The harpoon is in the right hand. No coral. Tier I only. No back flag.
